title: Door Project Size Step
content:
# Door Project Size Step

Window Replacement Contracts. A door-project step is added to the window series bundle percentage by the signed price of the paired Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract: at least $8000.00 (the large door-project price) adds the large door step of 0.02 (2 percentage points); at least $4000.00 (the mid door-project price) but less than $8000.00 adds the mid door step of 0.01 (1 percentage point); a lower price adds nothing.

The step is added to the window series bundle percentage, and the sum is the bundle rate at which the credit is figured.

| Door contract signed price | Step added |
|---|---|
| $8000.00 or more | 0.02 |
| $4000.00 to $7999.99 | 0.01 |
| Below $4000.00 | 0 |

## Hypothetical rate

A window series bundle percentage of a hypothetical 2.5% with a door contract signed at $9,000 gives a rate of 4.5% (0.025 plus 0.02); at $3,999 the rate stays 2.5%.
